curriculum.name: person_on_call_at
curriculum.goal: Given a time, return the person on the first call scheduled at that time.
curriculum.gold:
PROCEDURE person_on_call_at(time:TIME)
$v0 = FIND CALL WHERE PARENT.WHEN={time}
$v1 = FIRST $v0
$v2 = GET $v1 WHO
RETURN $v2
END
